result.summary: Found several visual bugs: overlapping/garbled delivery text on a popular restaurant card, a truncated restaurant name in the horizontal carousel, and a broken delivery-time string.

issues.description: On the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, the delivery info text ('25-30 delivery') overlaps and collides with itself, producing unreadable garbled characters (looks like '25-3Edelivery').
issues.suggestion: Fix layout/stacking so delivery time and fee sit on one clean line with proper spacing (e.g. '25–30 min · €X delivery') and do not overlap.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated mid-word in the Fastest near you row, with no ellipsis treatment that keeps the name readable.
issues.suggestion: Apply consistent text truncation with ellipsis on a single line, or allow the card title to wrap/scale so the full name (or a sensible abbreviation) is visible.

issues.description: Delivery time string under Tokumaru reads as '25-3Edelivery' / incomplete '25-30 delivery' and is missing units (min) and fee formatting consistency with other cards.
issues.suggestion: Use the same format as other cards: '25–30 min' plus a clear delivery fee (or '€0 delivery'), with no overlapping layers.

issues.description: Category chips row shows a partial empty/white chip on the far right edge beyond 'Healthy', which can look like a clipped or broken control.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal padding and snap/scroll behavior so only intentional chip content peeks at the edge, or add fade/scroll affordance.
